subject: Important Information Regarding Your Recent Purchase
body: Dear Customer, We are writing to inform you about an issue with your recent purchase. It appears that there was a delay in processing your order, which may result in a slight delivery delay. Rest assured, we are working diligently to resolve this and get your order to you as soon as possible. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Should you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for your patience. Sincerely, Customer Service Team
